what: On each spot of the illustration map, a sprite strip as wide as the number of frames is laid as the spot background (the strip svg is baked in the skin color when attached, as a data URL), and background-position 0→100% is stepped one frame at a time with no curve (steps(n, jump-none), 3~8 frames · repeat .6~1.6s, the same method as the original), so the characters inside the facilities each fidget. On wide screens the cursor turns into a magnifier over a spot, and on screens without hover each spot gets a 40px magnifier tag. Pressing a spot turns on the veil in .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) and opens a slider already moved straight (0s) to that spot’s card (loop · .5s · gap 20 if swiper exists), and it closes with the close button · outside the veil · Esc. On phones, if the map is wider than the screen it first slides once to the center, and an arrow smoothly moves among three positions: left · center · right

options.--fx-frames: Number of strip cells per spot (CSS variable, spot’s style), default 1
options.--fx-dur: Band cycle length (CSS variable), default .6s — the original is .2s per cell
options.--fx-badge-x · --fx-badge-y: Phone magnifier table position (CSS variable, % relative to spot)
options.swiper: If off, even when swiper is present, a single-row strip is moved with transform
options.cursor: none means the magnifier cursor is not attached
options.start: If left, the phone map is not pushed at the start
options.paint: With transform, it isn’t baked in, the strip itself is cut and shifted with translateX (for graphics that can’t be used as a background — strips holding video or canvas inside)

use: Seat 1

from.where: index.html .ll-course — the original .c-sectionTopCourse__mapButton (background-size n×100% · @keyframes steps to background-position 100% 0 · steps(n, jump-none) · BBQ 3 frames .6s, athletic 6 frames 1.2s, slide 8 frames 1.6s, dome 7 frames 1.4s, picnic 7 frames 1.4s, workshop 4 frames .8s, dog run 4 frames .8s, campfire 3 frames .6s) + ModalCourse (slideToLoop(i, 0) in the order pressed, swiper speed 500 spaceBetween 20 loop, backdrop opacity .3s, phone map scroll left · center · right)

note: The band svg fill is baked once at attach, so after changing the Skin, data-fx must be removed and reattached for the new color to take. A spot with a single cell does not move because steps(1, jump-none) is invalid (same as the original’s two lodgings).
